scope: Special modes and shared security. Full SMB/NFS remains incomplete.

steps.name: Run sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev libexpat1-dev samba-testsuite
Run python -m pip install -r tests/smb-requirements.txt -r tests/nfs-requirements.txt
Run xmake f -y -c -p linux -a x86_64 -m release --m0=n --m1=y --toolchain=gcc --sanitizers=n

session teardown cancels pending locks before discarding signing and encryption keys
peer disconnect removes a pending waiter before granting the next connection
holder disconnect releases locks and wakes the surviving client

CREATE/QUERY/SET persistent DOS attributes, zero/no-change and NORMAL semantics; readonly open/delete checks and granted-handle authority

binary extended attributes on CREATE/QUERY/SET, case-insensitive updates, deletion, restart, NEED_EA and access rights; malformed chains reject atomically

NFSv3 mode is enforced, owner/group are mapped, nonowner chmod denied; NFSv4 advertises real ACL support
group mode checks use only verified AUTH_SYS groups; omitted groups and root-squashed groups cannot grant access

invalid ACL principal and flags fail before truncation; empty ACL denies data and owner can recover WRITE_ACL
